policy: A confirmed semantic bug class is closed only when its content-addressed record is GUARDED and every reproducer/guard reference remains present and machine-checkable.

classes.description: Qualification tests must derive mutable canonical qualification provenance from the registry and ledger instead of hard-coding a previously attested commit, workflow run, or pre-promotion state.

first_observed.signature: test_default_explorer_remains_fail_closed_without_external_artifact: expected False but canonical-static qualification was True

classes.root_cause: Qualification provenance promotion changed canonical source truth from NOT_RUN to PASS, while tests retained historical SHA/run/state oracles. Those tests were coupled to a prior repository epoch instead of the canonical state machine.
classes.closure_rule: Canonical qualification state and provenance are data-derived; a registered guard forbids hard-coded promoted qualification SHA/run oracles in the relevant tests; bug-sweep verifies the content-addressed class and guard references.

classes.description: Qualification failure cleanup must succeed even when execution stops before heartbeat or phase-log creation.

first_observed.signature: gzip: heartbeat.jsonl: No such file or directory

classes.root_cause: The always-run diagnostic finalizer treated an optional heartbeat file as mandatory, allowing cleanup to add a second failure and obscure the primary pre-Lean test failure.
classes.closure_rule: Failure-path finalization is standalone and idempotent, tolerates absent optional evidence, and the always-run workflow wrapper cannot replace a prior failure with a cleanup failure; fault injection is permanent and workflow usage is verified by bug-sweep.

classes.description: Repository scripts executed by an isolated virtual-environment interpreter must preserve the repository root on the Python import path when the package is not installed into that environment.

first_observed.signature: canonical-contract-links: unexpected ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cace_studio'

classes.root_cause: The PR validator invoked scripts/check_bug_sweep.py by filesystem path with an isolated venv that contained pytest but not CACE. Python set sys.path[0] to scripts/, so the repository package root was unavailable when the sweep imported cace_studio.
classes.closure_rule: The isolated validator explicitly exports the repository root for bug-sweep imports, a policy test requires that safe invocation, and the content-addressed registry verifies both guards remain live.

classes.description: Canonical consistency sweeps must permit a proof-contract upgrade to reach fresh qualification only when Git qualification drift independently proves that the old qualification is stale and the conflict is limited to contract hash/required-check transition blockers.

first_observed.signature: canonical-link conflict: old qualified ledger proof-contract SHA/check set differs from upgraded canonical contract before requalification

classes.root_cause: The bug sweep treated every ProofExplorer CONFLICT as an invalid repository state. During a deliberate proof-contract upgrade, the old ledger must remain immutable until fresh exact-head qualification succeeds, so strict equality created a bootstrap deadlock even though Git drift correctly marked the old evidence stale.
classes.closure_rule: Bug-sweep may classify a canonical qualification conflict as a pending requalification transition only if the claim/ledger still share the same contract ID, the ledger hash differs from the current contract, every structural blocker is an explicitly allowed contract-transition blocker, and Git drift reports proof_contracts.json as qualification-sensitive; all other conflicts remain fatal.

classes.description: Pull-request validation must execute every pytest file exercised by the canonical formal-qualification preflight so transition-state and proof-governance failures are caught before a manual formal run.

first_observed.signature: formal preflight failed tests/test_qualification_overlay_v337.py while prior PR validation was green

classes.root_cause: The collaboration PR gate and canonical formal workflow maintained separate hand-written pytest file lists. The PR gate omitted test_qualification_overlay_v337.py, allowing stale qualification-state assumptions to pass review and fail only after a manual formal qualification dispatch.
classes.closure_rule: The PR gate contains all canonical formal-preflight pytest files, a policy test derives both workflow test sets and fails if the formal set is not a subset of the PR set, the affected overlay test is qualification-sensitive, and bug-sweep keeps these guards content-addressed and live.

classes.description: Pull-request qualification preflight must use the same pinned Python runtime and uv bootstrap identity as canonical formal qualification so dependency resolution and test behavior cannot diverge by runner system Python.

first_observed.signature: PR preflight bootstrap could not resolve fastapi>=0.141.1 under system Python while canonical formal preflight resolves it under Python 3.13.15

classes.root_cause: The collaboration validator created its virtual environment from the runner's system Python while canonical formal qualification explicitly pins Python 3.13.15 through uv 0.12.13. The older system interpreter filtered newer dependency releases, so supposedly mirrored preflight environments were not actually equivalent.
classes.closure_rule: Both PR and canonical formal preflights declare the same uv version and Python version, policy tests derive and compare those pins across workflows, and the content-addressed bug registry keeps the parity guards live.
